title: Green Monster in Living Room
description: A green muscular monster with yellow eyes and sharp teeth looms menacingly in a modern living room, reaching toward a woman kneeling on the floor. The woman has short black hair, wears a blue crop top and shorts with thigh-high stockings, and holds a large hammer while looking over her shoulder at the creature.
prompt: A menacing large green muscular monster with yellow eyes and sharp teeth stands inside a modern living room with wooden ceiling and large windows showing a surreal striped cathedral outside. A short black-haired woman in a blue cut-out crop top, denim shorts and blue thigh-high stockings kneels on a patterned rug holding a large sledgehammer, looking back at the creature. Yellow sofa, wooden furniture, retro 70s aesthetic, detailed digital painting.
